provider.description: Required closed BYO provider — never inferred into the slot from key prefix.

AnnualRevenueWire.description: One fiscal year's revenue as its annual report first filed it.

restated_value.description: A later filing's different value for the same concept and period.

AppErrorBody.description: The shared framework error envelope emitted by `AppError::into_response`.

code.description: Only the paused reply (SPEC B5) sets this; every other error body omits the key entirely.

BookBlobBody.description:
The persisted browser book is a versioned, closed envelope. The server stores it opaquely, but
the contract names the stable sections rather than emitting an unconstrained JSON schema.

blob.description: Opaque FE PersistShapeV3 JSON object (or empty object when none stored).

CalendarWire.description: Releases from `from` to `to` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), soonest first.

horizons.description:
How far each schedule read reaches: one entry per schedule with a copy. A day after an
agency's `through` is not "nothing scheduled" for it; it has not published that far yet.
Absent from servers before 2026-10-16.

FactWire.description:
One reported XBRL value. `concept` is a stable key (Revenue, GrossProfit,
OperatingIncomeLoss, NetIncomeLoss, EarningsPerShareDiluted,
CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue); `prior_*` is the same concept's previous period of the
same length (or the previous balance-sheet date).

FilingKind.description: What a filing is about, from its form type and 8-K items.

FilingWire.description: One SEC filing. `url` is the filing's primary document on the SEC archive.

oneOf.description: Null unless every report in the window carries the group.

history.description: Every weekly report in the window, oldest first.

FuturesWire.description: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures positioning for index and Treasury futures.

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when this server fetched the data.

report_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the newest weekly report.

oneOf.description:
This section's state: `delayed` (the CFTC publishes late by design), or `last_good` when
the latest fetch failed and this is the copy kept from before. Absent from servers before
2026-10-15.

market_data.description:
`"live"` | `"paused"` | `"not_live"`: `MARKET_DATA_MODE`, read once at boot (SPEC B3).
Paused with no vendor key reports `not_live` (no feed exists to resume; canon P-1).

release.description: Deployed git revision, or null when the runtime cannot determine it.

HolderWire.description: One manager's 13F-HR position in the security at the quarter's end.

change_pts.description:
Change in points of shares outstanding since the prior quarter; null when the manager
didn't report the prior quarter.

manager.description: The filer's name as EDGAR lists it.

pct.description: % of shares outstanding; null for receipts or without a shares-outstanding figure.

shares.description: Shares (or depositary receipts, when `units` says so) held.

value.description: US dollars at the quarter's end, as filed.

HoldersWindowWire.description: The next quarter's 13F-HRs arriving: how many of the listed managers have filed by now.

HoldersWire.description:
The largest 13F holders at the last complete quarter, among the managers Convexa reads (the
largest 13F filers). Delayed by law: a 13F-HR is due 45 days after the quarter.

issuer.description: The issuer and class as the 13Fs name them.

quarter_end.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the quarter shown and the one compared with.

units.description: `shares` (% of shares outstanding) or `receipts` (depositary receipts held; no %).

InsiderTransactionWire.description: One Form 4 trade (code P or S, non-derivative).

filed.description: YYYY-MM-DD the Form 4 was filed (up to two business days later).

planned.description: The filing is marked as made under a Rule 10b5-1 plan.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the first and last trade in the window.

InsidersWire.description:
Form 4 open-market activity over the last `window_days`: `sales`/`buys` count transactions
coded S/P, `planned` counts those in filings marked as made under a Rule 10b5-1 plan.

clusters.description:
Buying clusters: 3+ insiders buying on the open market within 10 days, outside any 10b5-1
plan. Overlapping windows merge into one.

history_days.description:
The timeline's period: Form 4s filed in the last `history_days` (365), trades placed by
trade date. Roles, not names: `roles[i]` names insider `i` ("EVP and CFO", "Director 2").

history_filings.description: Form 4s filed in the period, and how many were read for the timeline.

history_reaches_back_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD: when not every filing was read, the oldest filing date the timeline reaches.

latest.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the newest Form 4 in the window.

sale_windows.description: 3+ insiders selling within 10 days (context, usually plan sales; never a cluster).

transactions.description: Every open-market purchase (P) and sale (S) in those filings, oldest trade first.

LiquidityWeekWire.description:
One H.4.1 Wednesday, $ millions: `net` = `fed_assets` − `tga` − `reverse_repo`. The TGA and
reverse repo are that Wednesday's, or the last business day's before it within four days.

LiquidityWire.description:
Net liquidity: the Fed's total assets less the Treasury General Account and overnight reverse
repo, weekly, at most 26 weeks, oldest first.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the latest H.4.1 Wednesday netted (released the Thursday after).

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when this server fetched the data.

oneOf.description:
This section's state (the three inputs are fetched and kept together): `updated`, or
`last_good` when the latest fetch failed and this is the copy kept from before. Absent from
servers before 2026-10-15.
Omitted entirely when the replay construct is unset (do not emit `session_tape: null`).

PeerRowWire.description: One company's reported quarter in the peer comparison (SEC XBRL frames).

entity.description: The filer as the frames name it.

gross_margin_pct.description: Gross profit over revenue, %; null when gross profit isn't tagged.

growth_pct.description: Revenue against the same calendar quarter a year earlier, %.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the filer's own fiscal quarter placed in the calendar quarter.

PeersWire.description: The note's company against its peer list on one calendar quarter (SEC XBRL frames).

min_peers.description: A comparison needs at least this many peers with the figure.

missing.description: Peers with no revenue in the quarter's frames: not filed yet, or not tagged.

rows.description: The subject first (when it filed), then peers by gross margin.

unknown.description: Peers EDGAR lists no company for.

PeriodicFilingWire.description: One of the latest two 10-Q/10-K/20-F/40-F filings and the headline facts it reported.

fiscal_year.description:
The filer's fiscal year and period for this filing (`fy`, `fp`: 2027, "Q2"); null until its
XBRL facts are in.

tagged.description: Every checked concept's value for this filing's own period; empty until its facts are in.

PositionGroupWire.description:
Net position (long minus short, contracts) of one trader group, ranked against three years of
weekly reports. `position_in_range` = (net − min) / (max − min), 0.5 when the range is flat.

p10_3y.description: 10th and 90th percentiles of the weekly nets in the window (linear interpolation).

weeks.description: Weekly reports in the three-year window.

PositionWeekWire.description: One weekly report's net positions, contracts; null where the report lacks that group.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the Tuesday the positions are as of.

PublicDataState.description: How an answer, or one part of it, came to be.

PublicFilingsWire.description:
`GET /api/public-data/filings`: filings of the last 90 days for the named tickers, newest
first (insider Forms 3, 4, 5 and 144 excluded). `missing` lists tickers SEC does not know.

checked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when the oldest of the filing lists used was fetched.

results.description:
Expected results windows for the named tickers with enough filing history. Absent from
servers before 2026-10-15.

oneOf.description:
SEC EDGAR's state in the P-2 words (`updated` when current; `last_good` when a fetch failed
and earlier copies are shown); null when no ticker was named. Absent from servers before
2026-10-15.

sources.description: SEC EDGAR's row (empty when no ticker was named). Absent from servers before 2026-10-15.

PublicMarketsWire.description: `GET /api/public-data/markets`. Each part is null when its source failed with nothing cached.

oneOf.description:
The macro release calendar; null when every schedule failed with nothing kept, or public
data is off. Absent from servers before 2026-10-15.

sources.description:
Treasury, CFTC, the OFR, the three liquidity inputs and the four release schedules. Absent
from servers before 2026-10-15 (the `ofr` row before 2026-10-25).

oneOf.description:
The fear–greed gauge (the Stress section); null only when public data is off. Absent from
servers before 2026-10-25.

PublicSourceState.description:
One source's standing, in the closed P-2 vocabulary: `updated` (fetched on its schedule),
`delayed` (fetched; the source publishes late by design), `last_good` (this cycle's fetch failed
and the copy served is the last good one), `source_down` (failed, nothing kept), `not_set_up`
(a required setting is missing) and `off` (`PUBLIC_DATA=off`).

PublicSourceWire.description: One upstream source and its state. `id` is the source's anchor on /credits (`finra-si`).

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD the data is for (a settlement, a report date), where the source has one.

checked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when this server fetched the copy it serves.

failed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when a fetch last failed, while that failure still stands.

PublicTickerWire.description:
`GET /api/public-data/tickers/{ticker}`. FINRA parts are null when FINRA has nothing for the
ticker, failed with nothing cached, or is switched off on this server (their states say
`off`); SEC parts carry their own state.

annual_revenue.description: Annual revenue for the latest five fiscal years, oldest first, as first filed.

oneOf.description:
SEC EDGAR's state, for `filings`, `insiders`, `periodic` and `annual_revenue`: `updated`
when the ticker map, the filing list, the company facts and the Form 4s all answered this
cycle; `last_good` when any of them failed (a kept copy, or a part left out), with the
reason in the `sec` source row's detail.

The largest 13F holders at the last complete quarter; null when public data is off or
EDGAR lists no company. Absent from servers before 2026-10-15 (fix round).

The company against its note's peer list on one calendar quarter; null when the ticker has
no peer list. Absent from servers before 2026-10-15 (fix round).

FINRA short interest's state in the P-2 words (`delayed` when current; `last_good` for a
copy kept after a failed fetch). Absent from servers before 2026-10-15.

As `short_interest_source_state`, for the daily short-sale volume files (`updated` when
current).

short_volume_state.description: As `short_interest_state`, for FINRA's daily short-sale volume files.

sources.description:
FINRA short interest, FINRA short-sale volume and SEC EDGAR, as answered for this ticker.
Absent from servers before 2026-10-15.

RatesWire.description:
Treasury yields. `latest` is the newest day with a 10-year yield; `year_ago` the last such day
on or before one year earlier; `daily` every published day of the last 400, oldest first.

fetched_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when this server fetched the data.

oneOf.description:
This section's state: `updated`, or `last_good` when the latest fetch failed and this is
the copy kept from before. Absent from servers before 2026-10-15.

egress_categories.description:
Export-only disclosure of every category sent across the boundary. The field is optional
on the shared recommendation envelope because post/status responses do not include export
prose; the export route always supplies all six entries.

RecommendationRequest.description:
Route-owned request shape. The service request remains a domain-independent type and is
populated through the explicit conversion below so the HTTP schema has one authority.

ReleaseWire.description: One scheduled release from an agency's published calendar.

moved_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD the agency had published before it moved the release.

time.description: HH:MM, Eastern time, when the agency states one.

ResultsBasisWire.description: What a results window is projected from.

ResultsWindowWire.description:
The window a company's next results are expected in: each of its last four results dates
carried forward by whole quarters (91 days) to the quarter after the latest. Only the newest
dates a quarter apart are used (a skipped quarter ends the run; an annual 20-F/40-F history
gets no window), and a projection more than a week past is dropped. An estimate, never an
announced date.

basis.description: The dates it is projected from, YYYY-MM-DD, newest first (at most four).

market_data.description:
`"live"` | `"paused"` | `"not_live"` (SPEC B4): `MARKET_DATA_MODE`, read once at boot;
paused with no vendor key reports `not_live` (canon P-1, as `/api/health`).

ScheduleHorizonWire.description: The last date one agency's published schedule lists.

through.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the latest release date in the agency's schedule as last read.

SessionStatusBody.description:
Exact identity response used by session, signup, and login.  Keep this separate from the
broader auth bootstrap envelope: generated clients rely on these four identity fields being
present even when their values are null for an anonymous session.

tape_time_et.description: Present as JSON null when the tape cursor is not yet vouched (no skip_serializing_if).

SettingsPatchBody.description:
Settings patch preserves absent versus explicit null without exposing an unconstrained JSON
object in the HTTP contract.

ShortInterestWire.description:
FINRA consolidated short interest at the latest settlement, with the last 12 settlements
(oldest first, the latest included).

ShortVolumeWire.description:
FINRA daily short-sale volume on the latest day found; `ratio` = short / total (0..1);
`avg_ratio` = mean daily ratio over `days` (at most 20 trading days).

daily.description: Every day averaged, oldest first (the latest included).

SimTradeGateBody.description:
Auth-only sim-trade gate response. This endpoint is deliberately not a recommendation
envelope: the caller only needs the authorization decision.

StressBandWire.description:
The gauge's band, decided on `gauge`: 0–24 `extreme_fear`, 25–44 `fear`, 45–55 `neutral`,
56–75 `greed`, 76–100 `extreme_greed`; each edge belongs to the calmer band.

StressCadenceWire.description: `daily` (the OFR, about two business days late) or `weekly` (the CFTC).

StressComponentWire.description:
One input of the gauge. It carries no state of its own: its data state (a last good copy, an
outage) is the `sources` row whose `id` is its `source`.

age.description: Weekdays (daily) or calendar days (weekly) from `as_of` to `judged_on`.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD of `raw`: the input's newest observation.

percentile.description:
0–100 in the raw value's direction, rounded half up to one decimal for display. Null
without data or with less than a year of it.

raw.description:
The as-of value: OFR index units (0 = average stress), or a CFTC net position (long minus
short) as a fraction of open interest. Null when the source answered nothing.

score.description:
0–100, 0 = extreme fear and 100 = extreme greed, rounded half up to one decimal for
display (the gauge averages the unrounded scores). Null where `percentile` is.

window.description: Observations in the window (the three calendar years ending `as_of`), `as_of` included.

StressInputWire.description:
One of the gauge's seven inputs, in table order: five OFR Financial Stress Index categories
and two CFTC positioning ratios.

StressLeaningWire.description: Which way a higher raw value leans.

StressReasonWire.description:
Why an input is not counted: `stale` (past 5 weekdays daily, 14 days weekly), `no_data` (its
source answered nothing and no copy is kept) or `short_history` (less than a year of it).

StressSourceWire.description: The id of an input's row in `sources` (and its /credits anchor).

StressWire.description:
The fear–greed gauge: seven public inputs, each a percentile of its own last three years,
flipped so 0 is extreme fear and 100 extreme greed, equally weighted, and published only when
at least 5 of 7 are fresh.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the oldest as-of among the counted OFR inputs; null when none counts.

gauge.description: 0–100: `mean` rounded half up. Null unless published.

judged_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the Eastern date freshness was judged on.

mean.description: The unrounded mean of the counted scores that `gauge` rounds. Null unless published.

published.description: True when at least 5 of the 7 inputs count.

backend.description: Scan store backend that holds the diary (`json` | `postgres`).

basis.description: Honest basis copy for the desk (FE may surface or ignore).

stored_count.description: Total samples stored for this symbol (may exceed `samples.len()` when limited).

TaggedFactWire.description: One checked XBRL concept's value for its filing's own period (quarter, year or period end).

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null for a balance-sheet value.

UniverseResponse.description: FE wire (`ScanUniverse`): `{ symbols, universe_size }` — not the internal universe.json shape.

default_view.description: Extra (ignored by FE; useful for operators / view editor).

UserSettingsBody.description: Exact settings read/write response; the server always returns a complete saved settings bag.

YieldPointWire.description: One day of constant-maturity Treasury yields, in percent. Null where not published.

info.description: Dealer-structure analytics, public market data, accounts and the synced paper book. Generated from the Rust types; the TypeScript client in libs/api is generated from this document.
info.title: Convexa API

get.summary: GET /api/auth/ai-key — full bootstrap (matrix + grok + preference + catalog).

put.summary: PUT /api/auth/ai-key — encrypt+store one provider slot; returns full bootstrap.

get.summary: GET /api/auth/google/callback — exchange code, set cookie, redirect to app.
GET /api/auth/google/start — 302 to Google, or 409 google_unavailable.

delete.summary: DELETE /api/auth/grok — unlink; clear path if it was grok_subscription.

get.summary: GET /api/auth/grok/callback — arm unavailable: redirect home with error, no token persist.
GET /api/auth/grok/start — 409 until xAI user-OAuth is verified (never 302 to a fabricated URL).

429.description: Account throttle after repeated failures, or the per-IP sign-in budget (middleware).

get.summary: GET /api/auth/session — always 200 identity shape.
GET /api/auth/settings

put.summary:
PUT /api/auth/settings — accepts raw JSON so `account_size`/`per_trade_cap` can distinguish
"absent" (no change) from "present as null" (clear) — a shape a typed `Option<T>` cannot carry.

get.summary: GET /api/book — signed-in; empty blob when no server copy yet.

put.summary: PUT /api/book — signed-in; latest-wins by `updated_at` (client clock; honest multi-device merge).

get.summary: GET /api/broker/book — always 200 typed envelope when signed in.
GET /api/broker/credential

put.summary: PUT /api/broker/credential — both halves required (no body echo on 422).

parameters.description: `handoff` (default) | `prompt`. The ±15% band is NOT a query knob.
parameters.name: budget

get.summary: Tracked-contract stats from the full warm chain (no new vendor fetch when warm).
GET /api/market-data?ticker=
Built-in personas (Python `src/core/personas.py` PERSONAS list — read-only).

`GET /api/price/{ticker}` — warm cache first; on miss, one fast stock snapshot
(not the options chain), then cache. Path A only.
`GET /api/prices?symbols=SPY,QQQ` — batch warm read; missing symbols listed separately.

parameters.description: Comma-separated tickers, at most 30 (A-Z, '.', '-'). Absent: an empty list.
parameters.name: tickers

get.summary: Recent SEC filings for a list of tickers.
Treasury yields and futures positioning.
Short data, insider activity, headline facts and recent filings for one ticker.

GET /api/recommendation/export/{ticker} — anonymous-ok, no LLM. Resolves a session
**optionally** (the mechanism `GET /api/recommendation/status/{ticker}` already uses) so a
signed-in owner's drawer has one source of truth; anonymous callers keep working unchanged.
GET /api/recommendation/status/{ticker} — always 200 when bundle exists.

post.summary:
POST /api/recommendation/{ticker} — auth outermost; paused answers the exact AC-3 503 (SPEC B2
amendment, GATE Z 2026-09-24); otherwise always 200 for rec outcomes.

parameters.description: Max samples (default 48, hard-capped at store MAX).
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: GET /api/signals?ticker=
GET /api/stream/prices?symbols=SPY,QQQ — multi-symbol live prices (must register before /{ticker}).
GET /api/stream/{ticker} — LiveUpdate-shaped SSE for one underlying.
GET /api/strike-profile?ticker=

parameters.name: expirations

parameters.description: Legacy open-position context fields are accepted for URL/schema parity only.
parameters.name: pos_expiration
